description:
🏡 Looking for a home that doesn't feel like a typical manufactured home? Take a tour of the Atmos! This beautiful 3-bedroom, 2-bath home is one of my favorites because it combines affordability with features you'd expect in a much more expensive home.

Inside you'll find full drywall throughout, Palm Harbor's exclusive Gorilla Construction, a spacious kitchen with a large pantry, oversized walk-in closets in every bedroom, and a primary suite with a spa-inspired bathroom you'll love coming home to. Even the utility room was designed with extra space and functionality in mind.

The exterior has outstanding curb appeal, and the entire home was built with comfort, quality, and everyday living in mind.

If you're ready to stop renting or simply want to upgrade, let's see what options are available for you. I'd love to show you this home in person.

📍 Palm Harbor Homes of Odessa
6700 Andrews Hwy • Odessa, TX
📞 (432) 653-5001

Message me today to schedule your personal tour!
